decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several portable and home speakers based on ratings, features, and brand reputation. The Sony SRS-XB43 and JBL Go 3 both stand out with excellent 4.7 ratings. While the Sony offers more power and features, the JBL Go 3 is highly rated, extremely portable, and well-priced for a standard wireless speaker. I also included the INSMY Retro and NOTABRICK models for their unique aesthetics and lighting features, and the JBL Clip 3 as a solid renewed option. Ultimately, I chose the JBL Go 3 for its balance of performance, brand reliability, and value.
